build_RawCache: build a RawCache for a transformer model with a specified length and device for KV cache storage
build_like_RawCache: build a RawCache with the same shape as another cache but on a different device with pinned memory
view_RawCache: create a view into a RawCache starting at a given offset with a specified length along the sequence axis
prepare_lane_Cache: prepare a DynCacheLane from a Cache by matching token sequences against cached nodes for prefill reuse
page_in_DynCache: page in KV cache data from host memory to GPU for a specific transformer layer using async CUDA streams
